Only files under `src/` were touched — nothing under `tests/`, no skips/xfails added.

**`src/auth.py`** (2 bugs)
- `has_permission` claimed case-insensitivity in its docstring but did `required in user_roles` (case-sensitive). Fixed to compare lowercased roles.
- `is_admin_or_owner` used `and` instead of `or`, so neither the owner alone nor an admin alone granted access. Changed to `or`.

**`src/inventory.py`** (3 bugs)
- `__init__(initial={})` used a mutable default dict, so all parameterless `Inventory()` instances shared storage. Changed to `None` default with a fresh copy per instance.
- `add` overwrote stock (`self._stock[sku] = qty`) instead of accumulating.
- `reserve` raised `OutOfStock` on `qty >= available`, disallowing reserving exactly the available quantity. Changed to `qty > available`.

**`src/text_utils.py`** (3 bugs)
- `slugify` didn't lowercase input.
- `slugify` only collapsed double dashes via `.replace("--", "-")`, leaving runs of 3+ (e.g. `hello   world!!!` → `hello--world`). Rewritten to collapse any run of separators into a single `-` and strip leading/trailing dashes.
- `truncate` appended the suffix on top of `max_len` chars (`text[:max_len] + suffix` = 11 chars for `max_len=10`). Now budgets the suffix's length into the slice, so the result is `≤ max_len`.
